info.title: Deformity External API
info.description: Organization-scoped form and workspace operations. See externalDocs for complete form payloads and settings.

post.summary: Create an AI or static form draft

draftSettings.description: Raw saved draft setting overrides, before they are merged with published settings. Present for draft responses only.

patch.description: Stages changes in the builder preview and returns the saved draft. Existing published content stays live unchanged until POST /forms/{formId}/publish is called. Omitted fields retain their current draft values.

delete.summary: Soft-delete a form and remove its custom domain mapping

post.summary: Create a classic form draft from a name and question strings
post.description: Creates a static form with required questions. Recognized email prompts become email fields; other questions become freeform fields. If workspaceId is omitted, uses the most recently updated active workspace in the authenticated organization. Saves a draft in the builder preview; call POST /forms/{formId}/publish before respondents can use the form.

name.description: Trimmed before validation; must not be blank.

items.description: Trimmed before validation; must not be blank.

formUrl.description: Relative respondent URL, such as /d/form-id. Unavailable until the form is published.

publishUrl.description: Relative publication endpoint, such as /api/v1/forms/form-id/publish. Send POST to publish the saved draft.

404.description: No active workspace found in the organization

post.description: Atomically promotes the saved builder draft to live content, including its points and settings. No request body is required. New forms become available to respondents, and existing forms replace their previously published content. Returns the published form. A form without a pending draft returns 409.

400.description: Invalid draft content, including a form with no points (error code empty_form). The draft remains editable.

403.description: Requested settings require a Pro plan or organization feature access.

409.description: No pending draft (draft_not_found), or a point ID became unavailable after the draft was saved (point_id_conflict). For an ID conflict, save new point IDs before publishing again; the draft remains pending.

apiKey.description: Create an organization-scoped key in Account > API Keys.

instantResponses.description: Requires a Pro plan whenever this field is included, even when false or null. Otherwise returns HTTP 403 with code pro_plan_required.

completionRedirect.description: A valid absolute HTTPS URL. Null, empty, or whitespace-only strings clear the redirect. Nonempty values are trimmed and must use the https: protocol; HTTP and malformed URLs return 400.

collectPartials.description: Requires a Pro plan whenever this field is included, even when false or null. Otherwise returns HTTP 403 with code pro_plan_required.

email.description: Comma-separated valid email addresses, or an empty string. Subject to the team recipient limit.

anyOf.description: Respondent email question IDs (stable across renames); at most five recipients per submission. Legacy question labels remain readable.

respondentFields.description: Respondent email question IDs (stable across renames); at most five recipients per submission. Legacy question labels remain readable.

customBranding.description: Requires a Pro plan whenever this field is included, even when false or null. Otherwise returns HTTP 403 with code pro_plan_required.

removeDeformityBranding.description: Requires a Pro plan whenever this field is included, even when false or null. Otherwise returns HTTP 403 with code pro_plan_required.

allowIndexing.description: Requires a Pro plan whenever this field is included, even when false or null. Otherwise returns HTTP 403 with code pro_plan_required.

responsePathCapture.description: Setting true requires this feature to be enabled for the organization; otherwise returns HTTP 403 with code response_path_capture_not_enabled.

metadata.description: Requires a Pro plan whenever this field is included, even when false or null. Otherwise returns HTTP 403 with code pro_plan_required.

id.description: Optional in requests. Omit for new points to generate an ID. Supplied IDs must be unique within the point list and must not belong to another form.

exportKey.description: Optional stable export name used in webhook answer_* fields and CSV/Google Sheets headers instead of the prompt. Must be unique within the form, including unkeyed point names. Reserved metadata names and choice-field suffixes are not allowed. Omit or use null for existing prompt-based behavior. Stored in body; flattened request fields are also accepted. Also supports prefilled answer URL fragments: #customer_email=alice%40example.com. Use the raw export key without answer_; URL-encode names and values and separate multiple answers with &. Keep the key unchanged across prompt edits. Prefills use #, while hidden values use ?. Export-key prefills take precedence over prompt-based prefills.

DraftFormSettings.description: Saved draft overrides, including settings editable through the builder. These are response fields; public API writes accept FormSettings.
